title: Astro-Mine SafetyVerdict v0.1
description: The auditable per-tick output of the Guard arbiter (RM-P1-GUARD-06; guard.md §3, §5, §6): the certified action, whether/why an intervention occurred, the invoked spec clause(s), the active layer, the barrier-margin certificate, plus reproducibility provenance (spec/model content hashes, Guard code version, input content hashes). A Core-catalogued Guard-owned message, streamed to MCAP and aggregated to Parquet so a shielded run's safety behaviour is replayable and Bench-scorable. The verdict only *records* the fail-safe decision the trusted Rust safety core already made (guard.md §9.1); telemetry is best-effort and never changes the certified action. Additive-only, RFC-gated (a safety-contract artifact). Canonical source of truth; the Pydantic model in astro_mine.guard.audit.model mirrors it.

verdict_version.description: Schema minor of this verdict record.

agent_id.description: The agent this verdict certifies an action for.

tick.description: The decision tick (from the agent's Observation).

sim_time_s.description: Elapsed simulation time of this tick (SI seconds; an interval, not an epoch).

spec_content_hash.description: The sha256:<hex> content address of the source SafetySpec — the exact reviewed contract (guard.md §5). Reported by the trusted core; never recomputed here.

compiled_content_hash.description: The sha256:<hex> content address of the CompiledSafetyModel the core enforces (the model version).

guard_code_version.description: The astro-mine-guard code version that produced this verdict (provenance).

layer.description: The active assurance layer that produced the certified action: 'primary' | 'shield' | 'backup' (carried as a string so an additive core layer never fails an existing consumer).

intervention.description: What Guard did to the proposed action: 'none' | 'modified' | 'fallback'.

reason.description: The audit reason: 'certified' | 'shield_corrected' | 'scalar_violated' | 'monitor_fired' | 'qp_uncertifiable' | 'bad_input' | 'watchdog_expired' (carried as a string — additive-friendly).

backup_kind.description: The backup behaviour when the arbiter fell back: 'brake_to_stop' | 'hold' | 'safe_state'; null when the primary/shield layer certified.

constraint_ids.description: The SafetySpec clause/constraint ids that fired this tick (the core's `fired`; empty unless a detect layer tripped). The invoked spec clause(s) — Guard's own contract, never the wrapped policy's internals.

certified_action.description: The single certified action the core emitted (a commanded acceleration of length spatial_dim). Never the raw proposed action (fail-safe, never fail-open).

min_barrier_margin.description: The smallest keep-out barrier margin this tick — the safety certificate (+inf when no keep-out term applies).

action_divergence.description: The L2 distance ‖certified - proposed‖ between the certified and the proposed action — Guard's own derived measure of shielding cost (0.0 on passthrough). A scalar, not the policy's proposed vector.

inputs_content_hash.description: The sha256:<hex> content address of the inputs the core certified against (signals + position + velocity + proposed action) — so a verdict ties to the exact inputs in force (guard.md §5 provenance).

shield_latency_us.description: Wall-clock latency of the per-tick core.step() call in microseconds. Environment-dependent — EXCLUDED from the reproducibility digest (astro_mine.guard.audit.model.SafetyVerdict.provenance).
